verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's docs show per-environment flag states for dev, staging and production, including an API toggle that switches a flag in one or more environments. SDK connections are documented as read-only access to a subset of flag data, and a hands-on probe minted one. However, nothing explicitly shows SDK keys scoped to a specific environment, and custom environments appear only on a higher pricing tier. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that SDK keys or connections are bound to a single environment, details on environment-scoped key management, and independent hands-on corroboration of per-environment isolation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage separate environments (dev/staging/prod) with independent flag states and scoped SDK keys

citations.quote: Use environments such as dev, staging, and production to enable or disable feature flags independently.
Feature flags can be enabled and disabled on a per-environment basis.
switches a flag on or off in one or more environments
The SDK Connection Endpoint provides readonly access to a subset of your feature flag data
